# DataForSEO Google Play App Listings Search API

Search the Google Play catalog by app title or description and get ratings, review counts, installs and prices for each match.

Request fields follow the official DataForSEO `/v3/app_data/google/app_listings/search/live` task schema (one task per call). The response is DataForSEO's original JSON; results are in `tasks[].result`.

## Request

```bash
curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/dataforseo/v3/app_data/google/app_listings/search/live" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"title": "vpn", "limit": 10}'
```

## Parameters

The JSON body is forwarded to the upstream endpoint. Main fields:

| Name | Description |
|---|---|
| `title` | Words to match in app titles. |
| `description` | Optional words to match in app descriptions. |
| `limit` | Maximum number of apps to return. |
| `filters` | Optional filter array, e.g. [["rating.value", ">", 4]]. |

## Reference

- Official docs: https://docs.dataforseo.com/v3/app_data/google/app_listings/search/live/

## Pricing

Billed at the actual cost of each call, about $0.11 for the request above. The cost grows with the number of rows, targets or tokens a call returns. Failed calls are not charged. Searches with no results are billed at their actual cost.
